title: Thai-Marinated Beef Steak Salad
description: Thinly sliced grilled beef tossed with fresh herbs, lime dressing and crunchy vegetables.
steps: Whisk the lime juice, fish sauce, soy sauce, honey and garlic; marinate the steak 15 minutes.
Grill the steak 3-4 minutes per side, rest, then slice thin against the grain.
Toss the greens and vegetables with the remaining dressing, top with the steak, herbs and peanuts.

source.label: Adapted from Skinnytaste Thai-marinated steak salad

notes: Lime acid helps kick-start digestion, and slicing against the grain keeps the steak tender.
